help.title: Help and getting started
help.description: Understand the demonstration scope, your profile, and where to find module instructions.
help.demo: Confirm that you are in the demo environment and use synthetic data only.
help.profile: Review your profile and the capabilities shown in the menu.
help.start: Open Patients or Clinical check according to your scope.
help.ai: Treat AI output only as a proposal or explanation; it does not decide.
help.guide: Use the detailed guide for prerequisites, errors, and audit trail information.
